verses.en: Simon Peter, a servant and an apostle of Jesus Christ, to them that have obtained like precious faith with us through the righteousness of God and our Saviour Jesus Christ:
verses.fr: Simon Pierre, serviteur et apôtre de Jésus-Christ, à ceux qui ont reçu en partage une foi du même prix que la nôtre, par la justice de notre Dieu et du Sauveur Jésus-Christ:
verses.am: የኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ ባሪያና ሐዋርያ የሆነ ስምዖን ጴጥሮስ፥ በአምላካችንና በመድኃኒታችን በኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ ጽድቅ ካገኘነው ጋር የተካከለ የክብር እምነትን ላገኙ፤

verses.en: Grace and peace be multiplied unto you through the knowledge of God, and of Jesus our Lord,
verses.fr: que la grâce et la paix vous soient multipliées par la connaissance de Dieu et de Jésus notre Seigneur!

verses.en: According as his divine power hath given unto us all things that pertain unto life and godliness, through the knowledge of him that hath called us to glory and virtue:
verses.fr: Comme sa divine puissance nous a donné tout ce qui contribue à la vie et à la piété, au moyen de la connaissance de celui qui nous a appelés par sa propre gloire et par sa vertu,
verses.am: የመለኮቱ ኃይል፥ በገዛ ክብሩና በበጎነቱ የጠራንን በማወቅ፥ ለሕይወትና እግዚአብሔርን ለመምሰል የሚሆነውን ነገር ሁሉ ስለ ሰጠን፥ በእግዚአብሔርና በጌታችን በኢየሱስ እውቀት ጸጋና ሰላም ይብዛላችሁ።

verses.en: Whereby are given unto us exceeding great and precious promises: that by these ye might be partakers of the divine nature, having escaped the corruption that is in the world through lust.
verses.fr: lesquelles nous assurent de sa part les plus grandes et les plus précieuses promesses, afin que par elles vous deveniez participants de la nature divine, en fuyant la corruption qui existe dans le monde par la convoitise,
verses.am: ስለ ክፉ ምኞት በዓለም ካለው ጥፋት አምልጣችሁ ከመለኮት ባሕርይ ተካፋዮች በተስፋ ቃል እንድትሆኑ፥ በእነዚያ ክብርና በጎነት የተከበረና እጅግ ታላቅ የሆነ ተስፋን ሰጠን።

verses.en: And beside this, giving all diligence, add to your faith virtue; and to virtue knowledge;
verses.fr: à cause de cela même, faites tous vos efforts pour joindre à votre foi la vertu, à la vertu la science,
verses.am: ስለዚህም ምክንያት ትጋትን ሁሉ እያሳያችሁ በእምነታችሁ በጎነትን ጨምሩ፥

verses.en: And to knowledge temperance; and to temperance patience; and to patience godliness;
verses.fr: à la science la tempérance, à la tempérance la patience, à la patience la piété,
verses.am: በበጎነትም እውቀትን፥ በእውቀትም ራስን መግዛት፥ ራስንም በመግዛት መጽናትን፥ በመጽናትም እግዚአብሔርን መምሰል፥

verses.en: And to godliness brotherly kindness; and to brotherly kindness charity.
verses.fr: à la piété l''amour fraternel, à l''amour fraternel la charité.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርንም በመምሰል የወንድማማችን መዋደድ፥ በወንድማማችም መዋደድ ፍቅርን ጨምሩ።

verses.en: For if these things be in you, and abound, they make you that ye shall neither be barren nor unfruitful in the knowledge of our Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.fr: Car si ces choses sont en vous, et y sont avec abondance, elles ne vous laisseront point oisifs ni stériles pour la connaissance de notre Seigneur Jésus-Christ.
verses.am: እነዚህ ነገሮች ለእናንተ ሆነው ቢበዙ፥ በጌታችን በኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ እውቀት ሥራ ፈቶችና ፍሬ ቢሶች እንዳትሆኑ ያደርጉአችኋልና፤

verses.en: But he that lacketh these things is blind, and cannot see afar off, and hath forgotten that he was purged from his old sins.
verses.fr: Mais celui en qui ces choses ne sont point est aveugle, il ne voit pas de loin, et il a mis en oubli la purification de ses anciens péchés.
verses.am: እነዚህ ነገሮች የሌሉት ዕውር ነውና፥ በቅርብም ያለውን ብቻ ያያል፥ የቀደመውንም ኃጢአቱን መንጻት ረስቶአል።

verses.en: Wherefore the rather, brethren, give diligence to make your calling and election sure: for if ye do these things, ye shall never fall:
verses.fr: C''est pourquoi, frères, appliquez-vous d''autant plus à affermir votre vocation et votre élection; car, en faisant cela, vous ne broncherez jamais.
verses.am: ስለዚህ፥ ወንድሞች ሆይ፥ መጠራታችሁንና መመረጣችሁን ታጸኑ ዘንድ ከፊት ይልቅ ትጉ፤ እነዚህን ብታደርጉ ከቶ አትሰናከሉምና።

verses.en: For so an entrance shall be ministered unto you abundantly into the everlasting kingdom of our Lord and Saviour Jesus Christ.
verses.fr: C''est ainsi, en effet, que l''entrée dans le royaume éternel de notre Seigneur et Sauveur Jésus-Christ vous sera pleinement accordée.
verses.am: እንዲሁ ወደ ዘላለሙ ወደ ጌታችንና መድኃኒታችን ወደ ኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ መንግሥት መግባት በሙላት ይሰጣችኋልና።

verses.en: Wherefore I will not be negligent to put you always in remembrance of these things, though ye know them, and be established in the present truth.
verses.fr: Voilà pourquoi je prendrai soin de vous rappeler ces choses, bien que vous les sachiez et que vous soyez affermis dans la vérité présente.
verses.am: ስለዚህ እነዚህን ነገሮች ምንም ብታውቁ በእናንተም ዘንድ ባለ እውነት ምንም ብትጸኑ፥ ስለ እነዚህ ዘወትር እንዳሳስባችሁ ቸል አልልም።

verses.en: Yea, I think it meet, as long as I am in this tabernacle, to stir you up by putting you in remembrance;
verses.fr: Et je regarde comme un devoir, aussi longtemps que je suis dans cette tente, de vous tenir en éveil par des avertissements,
verses.am: ሁልጊዜም በዚህ ማደሪያ ሳለሁ በማሳሰቤ ላነቃችሁ የሚገባኝ ይመስለኛል።

verses.en: Knowing that shortly I must put off this my tabernacle, even as our Lord Jesus Christ hath shewed me.
verses.fr: car je sais que je la quitterai subitement, ainsi que notre Seigneur Jésus-Christ me l''a fait connaître.
verses.am: ጌታችን ኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ እንዳመለከተኝ ከዚህ ማደሪያዬ መለየቴ ፈጥኖ እንዲሆን አውቃለሁና።

verses.en: Moreover I will endeavour that ye may be able after my decease to have these things always in remembrance.
verses.fr: Mais j''aurai soin qu''après mon départ vous puissiez toujours vous souvenir de ces choses.
verses.am: ከመውጣቴም በኋላ እነዚህን ነገሮች እንድታስቡ በየጊዜው ትችሉ ዘንድ እተጋለሁ።

verses.en: For we have not followed cunningly devised fables, when we made known unto you the power and coming of our Lord Jesus Christ, but were eyewitnesses of his majesty.
verses.fr: Ce n''est pas, en effet, en suivant des fables habilement conçues, que nous vous avons fait connaître la puissance et l''avènement de notre Seigneur Jésus-Christ, mais c''est comme ayant vu sa majesté de nos propres yeux.
verses.am: የእርሱን ግርማ አይተን እንጂ በብልሃት የተፈጠረውን ተረት ሳንከተል የጌታችንን የኢየሱስ ክርስቶስን ኃይልና መምጣት አስታወቅናችሁ።

verses.en: For he received from God the Father honour and glory, when there came such a voice to him from the excellent glory, This is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased.
verses.fr: Car il a reçu de Dieu le Père honneur et gloire, quand la gloire magnifique lui fit entendre une voix qui disait: Celui-ci est mon Fils bien-aimé, en qui j''ai mis toute mon affection.
verses.am: ከገናናው ክብር። በእርሱ ደስ የሚለኝ የምወደው ልጄ ይህ ነው የሚል ያ ድምፅ በመጣለት ጊዜ ከእግዚአብሔር አብ ክብርንና ምስጋናን ተቀብሎአልና፤

verses.en: And this voice which came from heaven we heard, when we were with him in the holy mount.
verses.fr: Et nous avons entendu cette voix venant du ciel, lorsque nous étions avec lui sur la sainte montagne.
verses.am: እኛም በቅዱሱ ተራራ ከእርሱ ጋር ሳለን ይህን ድምፅ ከሰማይ ሲወርድ ሰማን።

verses.en: We have also a more sure word of prophecy; whereunto ye do well that ye take heed, as unto a light that shineth in a dark place, until the day dawn, and the day star arise in your hearts:
verses.fr: Et nous tenons pour d''autant plus certaine la parole prophétique, à laquelle vous faites bien de prêter attention, comme à une lampe qui brille dans un lieu obscur, jusqu''à ce que le jour vienne à paraître et que l''étoile du matin se lève dans vos coeurs;
verses.am: ከእርሱም ይልቅ እጅግ የጸና የትንቢት ቃል አለን፤ ምድርም እስኪጠባ ድረስ የንጋትም ኮከብ በልባችሁ እስኪወጣ ድረስ፥ ሰው በጨለማ ስፍራ የሚበራን መብራት እንደሚጠነቀቅ ይህን ቃል እየጠነቀቃችሁ መልካም ታደርጋላችሁ።

verses.en: Knowing this first, that no prophecy of the scripture is of any private interpretation.
verses.fr: sachant tout d''abord vous-mêmes qu''aucune prophétie de l''Ecriture ne peut être un objet d''interprétation particulière,
verses.am: ይህን በመጀመሪያ እወቁ፤ በመጽሐፍ ያለውን ትንቢት ሁሉ ማንም ለገዛ ራሱ ሊተረጉም አልተፈቀደም፤

verses.en: For the prophecy came not in old time by the will of man: but holy men of God spake as they were moved by the Holy Ghost.
verses.fr: car ce n''est pas par une volonté d''homme qu''une prophétie a jamais été apportée, mais c''est poussés par le Saint-Esprit que des hommes ont parlé de la part de Dieu.
verses.am: ትንቢት ከቶ በሰው ፈቃድ አልመጣምና፥ ዳሩ ግን በእግዚአብሔር ተልከው ቅዱሳን ሰዎች በመንፈስ ቅዱስ ተነድተው ተናገሩ።

verses.en: But there were false prophets also among the people, even as there shall be false teachers among you, who privily shall bring in damnable heresies, even denying the Lord that bought them, and bring upon themselves swift destruction.
verses.fr: Il y a eu parmi le peuple de faux prophètes, et il y aura de même parmi vous de faux docteurs, qui introduiront des sectes pernicieuses, et qui, reniant le maître qui les a rachetés, attireront sur eux une ruine soudaine.
verses.am: ነገር ግን ሐሰተኞች ነቢያት ደግሞ በሕዝቡ መካከል ነበሩ እንዲሁም በመካከላችሁ ደግሞ ሐሰተኞች አስተማሪዎች ይሆናሉ፤ እነርሱም የዋጃቸውን ጌታ እንኳ ክደው የሚፈጥንን ጥፋት በራሳቸው ላይ እየሳቡ የሚያጠፋ ኑፋቄን አሹልከው ያገባሉ፤

verses.en: And many shall follow their pernicious ways; by reason of whom the way of truth shall be evil spoken of.
verses.fr: Plusieurs les suivront dans leurs dissolutions, et la voie de la vérité sera calomniée à cause d''eux.
verses.am: ብዙዎችም በመዳራታቸው ይከተሉአቸዋል በእነርሱም ጠንቅ የእውነት መንገድ ይሰደባል።

verses.en: And through covetousness shall they with feigned words make merchandise of you: whose judgment now of a long time lingereth not, and their damnation slumbereth not.
verses.fr: Par cupidité, ils trafiqueront de vous au moyen de paroles trompeuses, eux que menace depuis longtemps la condamnation, et dont la ruine ne sommeille point.
verses.am: ገንዘብንም በመመኘት በተፈጠረ ነገር ይረቡባችኋል፤ ፍርዳቸውም ከጥንት ጀምሮ አይዘገይም ጥፋታቸውም አያንቀላፋም።

verses.en: For if God spared not the angels that sinned, but cast them down to hell, and delivered them into chains of darkness, to be reserved unto judgment;
verses.fr: Car, si Dieu n''a pas épargné les anges qui ont péché, mais s''il les a précipités dans les abîmes de ténèbres et les réserve pour le jugement;
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ኃጢአትን ላደረጉ መላእክት ሳይራራላቸው ወደ ገሃነም ጥሎ በጨለማ ጉድጓድ ለፍርድ ሊጠበቁ አሳልፎ ከሰጣቸው፥

verses.en: And spared not the old world, but saved Noah the eighth person, a preacher of righteousness, bringing in the flood upon the world of the ungodly;
verses.fr: s''il n''a pas épargné l''ancien monde, mais s''il a sauvé Noé, lui huitième, ce prédicateur de la justice, lorsqu''il fit venir le déluge sur un monde d''impies;
verses.am: ለቀደመውም ዓለም ሳይራራ ከሌሎች ሰባት ጋር ጽድቅን የሚሰብከውን ኖኅን አድኖ በኃጢአተኞች ዓለም ላይ የጥፋትን ውኃ ካወረደ፥

verses.en: And turning the cities of Sodom and Gomorrha into ashes condemned them with an overthrow, making them an ensample unto those that after should live ungodly;
verses.fr: s''il a condamné à la destruction et réduit en cendres les villes de Sodome et de Gomorrhe, les donnant comme exemple aux impies à venir,
verses.am: ኃጢአትንም ያደርጉ ዘንድ ላሉት ምሳሌ አድርጎ ከተማዎችን ሰዶምንና ገሞራን አመድ እስኪሆኑ ድረስ አቃጥሎና ገልብጦ ከፈረደባቸው፥

verses.en: And delivered just Lot, vexed with the filthy conversation of the wicked:
verses.fr: et s''il a délivré le juste Lot, profondément attristé de la conduite de ces hommes sans frein dans leur dissolution

verses.en: (For that righteous man dwelling among them, in seeing and hearing, vexed his righteous soul from day to day with their unlawful deeds;)
verses.fr: car ce juste, qui habitait au milieu d''eux, tourmentait journellement son âme juste à cause de ce qu''il voyait et entendait de leurs oeuvres criminelles;
verses.am: ጻድቅ ሎጥም በመካከላቸው ሲኖር እያየና እየሰማ ዕለት ዕለት በዓመፀኛ ሥራቸው ጻድቅ ነፍሱን አስጨንቆ ነበርና በዓመፀኞች ሴሰኛ ኑሮ የተገፋውን ያን ጻድቅ ካዳነ፥

verses.en: The Lord knoweth how to deliver the godly out of temptations, and to reserve the unjust unto the day of judgment to be punished:
verses.fr: le Seigneur sait délivrer de l''épreuve les hommes pieux, et réserver les injustes pour être punis au jour du jugement,
verses.am: ዳሩ ግን መላእክት በኃይልና በብርታት ከእነርሱ ይልቅ ምንም ቢበልጡ በጌታ ፊት በእነርሱ ላይ የስድብን ፍርድ አያመጡም።

verses.en: But chiefly them that walk after the flesh in the lust of uncleanness, and despise government. Presumptuous are they, selfwilled, they are not afraid to speak evil of dignities.
verses.fr: ceux surtout qui vont après la chair dans un désir d''impureté et qui méprisent l''autorité. Audacieux et arrogants, ils ne craignent pas d''injurier les gloires,
verses.am: ዳሩ ግን መላእክት በኃይልና በብርታት ከእነርሱ ይልቅ ምንም ቢበልጡ በጌታ ፊት በእነርሱ ላይ የስድብን ፍርድ አያመጡም።

verses.en: Whereas angels, which are greater in power and might, bring not railing accusation against them before the Lord.
verses.fr: tandis que les anges, supérieurs en force et en puissance, ne portent pas contre elles de jugement injurieux devant le Seigneur.
verses.am: እነዚህ ግን ለመጠመድና ለመጥፋት በፍጥረታቸው እንደ ተወለዱ አእምሮ እንደ ሌላቸው እንስሶች ሆነው፥ በማያውቁት ነገር እየተሳደቡ በጥፋታቸው ይጠፋሉ፤

verses.en: But these, as natural brute beasts, made to be taken and destroyed, speak evil of the things that they understand not; and shall utterly perish in their own corruption;
verses.fr: Mais eux, semblables à des brutes qui s''abandonnent à leurs penchants naturels et qui sont nées pour être prises et détruites, ils parlent d''une manière injurieuse de ce qu''ils ignorent, et ils périront par leur propre corruption,
verses.am: የዓመፃቸውን ደመወዝ ይቀበላሉ። በቀን ሲዘፍኑ እንደ ተድላ ይቆጥሩታል፤ ነውረኞችና ርኵሳን ሆነው ከእናንተ ጋር ሲጋበዙ በፍቅር ግብዣ ይዘፍናሉ፤

verses.en: And shall receive the reward of unrighteousness, as they that count it pleasure to riot in the day time. Spots they are and blemishes, sporting themselves with their own deceivings while they feast with you;
verses.fr: recevant ainsi le salaire de leur iniquité. Ils trouvent leurs délices à se livrer au plaisir en plein jour; hommes tarés et souillés, ils se délectent dans leurs tromperies, en faisant bonne chère avec vous.
verses.am: ምንዝር የሞላባቸው ኃጢአትንም የማይተዉ ዓይኖች አሉአቸው፤ የማይጸኑትን ነፍሳት ያታልላሉ፤ መመኘትን የለመደ ልብ አላቸው፤ የተረገሙ ናቸው።

verses.en: Having eyes full of adultery, and that cannot cease from sin; beguiling unstable souls: an heart they have exercised with covetous practices; cursed children:
verses.fr: Ils ont les yeux pleins d''adultère et insatiables de péché; ils amorcent les âmes mal affermies; ils ont le coeur exercé à la cupidité; ce sont des enfants de malédiction.
verses.am: ቅንን መንገድ ትተው ተሳሳቱ፤ የባሶርን ልጅ የበለዓምን መንገድ ተከተሉ፤ እርሱ የዓመፃን ደመወዝ ወደደ፥

verses.en: Which have forsaken the right way, and are gone astray, following the way of Balaam the son of Bosor, who loved the wages of unrighteousness;
verses.fr: Après avoir quitté le droit chemin, ils se sont égarés en suivant la voie de Balaam, fils de Bosor, qui aima le salaire de l''iniquité,
verses.am: ነገር ግን ስለ መተላለፉ ተዘለፈ፤ ቃል የሌለው አህያ በሰው ቃል ተናግሮ የነቢዩን እብድነት አገደ።

verses.en: But was rebuked for his iniquity: the dumb ass speaking with man's voice forbad the madness of the prophet.
verses.fr: mais qui fut repris pour sa transgression: une ânesse muette, faisant entendre une voix d''homme, arrêta la démence du prophète.
verses.am: ድቅድቅ ጨለማ ለዘላለም የተጠበቀላቸው እነዚህ ውኃ የሌለባቸው ምንጮች በዐውሎ ነፋስም የተነዱ ደመናዎች ናቸው።

verses.en: These are wells without water, clouds that are carried with a tempest; to whom the mist of darkness is reserved for ever.
verses.fr: Ces gens-là sont des fontaines sans eau, des nuées que chasse un tourbillon: l''obscurité des ténèbres leur est réservée.
verses.am: ከንቱና ከመጠን ይልቅ ታላቅ የሆነውን ቃል ይናገራሉና፥ በስሕተትም ከሚኖሩት አሁን የሚያመልጡትን በሥጋ ሴሰኛ ምኞት ያታልላሉ።

verses.en: For when they speak great swelling words of vanity, they allure through the lusts of the flesh, through much wantonness, those that were clean escaped from them who live in error.
verses.fr: Avec des discours enflés de vanité, ils amorcent par les convoitises de la chair, par les dissolutions, ceux qui viennent à peine d''échapper aux hommes qui vivent dans l''égarement;
verses.am: ራሳቸው የጥፋት ባሪያዎች ሆነው። አርነት ትወጣላችሁ እያሉ ተስፋ ይሰጡአቸዋል፤ ሰው ለተሸነፈበት ለእርሱ ተገዝቶ ባሪያ ነውና።

verses.en: While they promise them liberty, they themselves are the servants of corruption: for of whom a man is overcome, of the same is he brought in bondage.
verses.fr: ils leur promettent la liberté, quand ils sont eux-mêmes esclaves de la corruption, car chacun est esclave de ce qui a triomphé de lui.
verses.am: በጌታችንና በመድኃኒታችን በኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ እውቀት ከዓለም ርኵሰት ካመለጡ በኋላ ዳግመኛ በእርስዋ ተጠላልፈው የተሸነፉ ቢሆኑ፥ ከፊተኛው ኑሮአቸው ይልቅ የኋለኛው የባሰ ሆኖባቸዋል።

verses.en: For if after they have escaped the pollutions of the world through the knowledge of the Lord and Saviour Jesus Christ, they are again entangled therein, and overcome, the latter end is worse with them than the beginning.
verses.fr: En effet, si, après s''être retirés des souillures du monde, par la connaissance du Seigneur et Sauveur Jésus-Christ, ils s''y engagent de nouveau et sont vaincus, leur dernière condition est pire que la première.
verses.am: አውቀዋት ከተሰጣቸው ከቅድስት ትእዛዝ ከሚመለሱ የጽድቅን መንገድ ባላወቋት በተሻላቸው ነበርና።

verses.en: For it had been better for them not to have known the way of righteousness, than, after they have known it, to turn from the holy commandment delivered unto them.
verses.fr: Car mieux valait pour eux n''avoir pas connu la voie de la justice, que de se détourner, après l''avoir connue, du saint commandement qui leur avait été donné.
verses.am: ውሻ ወደ ትፋቱ ይመለሳል፥ ደግሞ። የታጠበች እርያ በጭቃ ለመንከባለል ትመለሳለች እንደሚባል እውነተኞች ምሳሌዎች ሆኖባቸዋል።

verses.en: But it is happened unto them according to the true proverb, The dog is turned to his own vomit again; and the sow that was washed to her wallowing in the mire.
verses.fr: Il leur est arrivé ce que dit un proverbe vrai: Le chien est retourné à ce qu''il avait vomi, et la truie lavée s''est vautrée dans le bourbier.
verses.am: ውሻ ወደ ትፋቱ ይመለሳል፥ ደግሞ። የታጠበች እርያ በጭቃ ለመንከባለል ትመለሳለች እንደሚባል እውነተኞች ምሳሌዎች ሆኖባቸዋል።

verses.en: This second epistle, beloved, I now write unto you; in both which I stir up your pure minds by way of remembrance:
verses.fr: Voici déjà, bien-aimés, la seconde lettre que je vous écris. Dans l''une et dans l''autre je cherche à éveiller par des avertissements votre saine intelligence,

verses.en: That ye may be mindful of the words which were spoken before by the holy prophets, and of the commandment of us the apostles of the Lord and Saviour:
verses.fr: afin que vous vous souveniez des choses annoncées d''avance par les saints prophètes, et du commandement du Seigneur et Sauveur, enseigné par vos apôtres,
verses.am: ወዳጆች ሆይ፥ አሁን የምጽፍላችሁ መልእክት ይህች ሁለተኛይቱ ናት። በቅዱሳን ነቢያትም ቀድሞ የተባለውን ቃል በሐዋርያቶቻችሁም ያገኛችኋትን የጌታንና የመድኃኒትን ትእዛዝ እንድታስቡ በሁለቱ እያሳሰብኋችሁ ቅን ልቡናችሁን አነቃቃለሁ።

verses.en: Knowing this first, that there shall come in the last days scoffers, walking after their own lusts,
verses.fr: sachant avant tout que, dans les derniers jours, il viendra des moqueurs avec leurs railleries, marchant selon leurs propres convoitises,
verses.am: በመጨረሻው ዘመን እንደ ራሳቸው ምኞት የሚመላለሱ ዘባቾች በመዘበት እንዲመጡ ይህን በፊት እወቁ፤

verses.en: And saying, Where is the promise of his coming? for since the fathers fell asleep, all things continue as they were from the beginning of the creation.
verses.fr: et disant: Où est la promesse de son avènement? Car, depuis que les pères sont morts, tout demeure comme dès le commencement de la création.
verses.am: እነርሱም። የመምጣቱ የተስፋ ቃል ወዴት ነው? አባቶች ከሞቱባት ጊዜ፥ ከፍጥረት መጀመሪያ ይዞ ሁሉ እንዳለ ይኖራልና ይላሉ።

verses.en: For this they willingly are ignorant of, that by the word of God the heavens were of old, and the earth standing out of the water and in the water:
verses.fr: Ils veulent ignorer, en effet, que des cieux existèrent autrefois par la parole de Dieu, de même qu''une terre tirée de l''eau et formée au moyen de l''eau,
verses.am: ሰማያት ከጥንት ጀምረው ምድርም በእግዚአብሔር ቃል ከውኃ ተጋጥማ በውኃ መካከል እንደ ነበሩ ወደው አያስተውሉምና፤

verses.en: Whereby the world that then was, being overflowed with water, perished:
verses.fr: et que par ces choses le monde d''alors périt, submergé par l''eau,
verses.am: በዚህም ምክንያት ያን ጊዜ የነበረ ዓለም በውኃ ሰጥሞ ጠፋ፤

verses.en: But the heavens and the earth, which are now, by the same word are kept in store, reserved unto fire against the day of judgment and perdition of ungodly men.
verses.fr: tandis que, par la même parole, les cieux et la terre d''à présent sont gardés et réservés pour le feu, pour le jour du jugement et de la ruine des hommes impies.
verses.am: አሁን ያሉ ሰማያትና ምድር ግን እግዚአብሔርን የማያመልኩት ሰዎች እስከሚጠፉበት እስከ ፍርድ ቀን ድረስ ተጠብቀው በዚያ ቃል ለእሳት ቀርተዋል።

verses.en: But, beloved, be not ignorant of this one thing, that one day is with the Lord as a thousand years, and a thousand years as one day.
verses.fr: Mais il est une chose, bien-aimés, que vous ne devez pas ignorer, c''est que, devant le Seigneur, un jour est comme mille ans, et mille ans sont comme un jour.
verses.am: እናንተ ግን ወዳጆች ሆይ፥ በጌታ ዘንድ አንድ ቀን እንደ ሺህ ዓመት፥ ሺህ ዓመትም እንደ አንድ ቀን እንደ ሆነ ይህን አንድ ነገር አትርሱ።

verses.en: The Lord is not slack concerning his promise, as some men count slackness; but is longsuffering to us-ward, not willing that any should perish, but that all should come to repentance.
verses.fr: Le Seigneur ne tarde pas dans l''accomplissement de la promesse, comme quelques-uns le croient; mais il use de patience envers vous, ne voulant pas qu''aucun périsse, mais voulant que tous arrivent à la repentance.
verses.am: ለአንዳንዶች የሚዘገይ እንደሚመስላቸው ጌታ ስለ ተስፋ ቃሉ አይዘገይም፥ ነገር ግን ሁሉ ወደ ንስሐ እንዲደርሱ እንጂ ማንም እንዳይጠፋ ወዶ ስለ እናንተ ይታገሣል።

verses.en: But the day of the Lord will come as a thief in the night; in the which the heavens shall pass away with a great noise, and the elements shall melt with fervent heat, the earth also and the works that are therein shall be burned up.
verses.fr: Le jour du Seigneur viendra comme un voleur; en ce jour, les cieux passeront avec fracas, les éléments embrasés se dissoudront, et la terre avec les oeuvres qu''elle renferme sera consumée.
verses.am: የጌታው ቀን ግን እንደ ሌባ ሆኖ ይመጣል፤ በዚያም ቀን ሰማያት በታላቅ ድምፅ ያልፋሉ፥ የሰማይም ፍጥረት በትልቅ ትኵሳት ይቀልጣል፥ ምድርም በእርስዋም ላይ የተደረገው ሁሉ ይቃጠላል።

verses.en: Seeing then that all these things shall be dissolved, what manner of persons ought ye to be in all holy conversation and godliness,
verses.fr: Puisque donc toutes ces choses doivent se dissoudre, quelles ne doivent pas être la sainteté de votre conduite et votre piété,
verses.am: ነገር ግን ጽድቅ የሚኖርባትን አዲስ ሰማይና አዲስ ምድር እንደ ተስፋ ቃሉ እንጠብቃለን።

verses.en: Looking for and hasting unto the coming of the day of God, wherein the heavens being on fire shall be dissolved, and the elements shall melt with fervent heat?
verses.fr: tandis que vous attendez et hâtez l''avènement du jour de Dieu, à cause duquel les cieux enflammés se dissoudront et les éléments embrasés se fondront!
verses.am: ነገር ግን ጽድቅ የሚኖርባትን አዲስ ሰማይና አዲስ ምድር እንደ ተስፋ ቃሉ እንጠብቃለን።

verses.en: Nevertheless we, according to his promise, look for new heavens and a new earth, wherein dwelleth righteousness.
verses.fr: Mais nous attendons, selon sa promesse, de nouveaux cieux et une nouvelle terre, où la justice habitera.
verses.am: ስለዚህ፥ ወዳጆች ሆይ፥ ይህን እየጠበቃችሁ ያለ ነውርና ያለ ነቀፋ ሆናችሁ በሰላም በእርሱ እንድትገኙ ትጉ፥

verses.en: Wherefore, beloved, seeing that ye look for such things, be diligent that ye may be found of him in peace, without spot, and blameless.
verses.fr: C''est pourquoi, bien-aimés, en attendant ces choses, appliquez-vous à être trouvés par lui sans tache et irrépréhensibles dans la paix.
verses.am: የጌታችንም ትዕግሥት መዳናችሁ እንደ ሆነ ቍጠሩ። እንዲህም የተወደደው ወንድማችን ጳውሎስ ደግሞ እንደ ተሰጠው ጥበብ መጠን ጻፈላችሁ፥ በመልእክቱም ሁሉ ደግሞ እንደ ነገረ ስለዚህ ነገር ተናገረ።

verses.en: And account that the longsuffering of our Lord is salvation; even as our beloved brother Paul also according to the wisdom given unto him hath written unto you;
verses.fr: Croyez que la patience de notre Seigneur est votre salut, comme notre bien-aimé frère Paul vous l''a aussi écrit, selon la sagesse qui lui a été donnée.
verses.am: በእነዚያ ዘንድ ለማስተዋል የሚያስቸግር ነገር አለ፥ ያልተማሩትና የማይጸኑትም ሰዎች ሌሎችን መጻሕፍት እንደሚያጣምሙ እነዚህን ደግሞ ለገዛ ጥፋታቸው ያጣምማሉ።

verses.en: As also in all his epistles, speaking in them of these things; in which are some things hard to be understood, which they that are unlearned and unstable wrest, as they do also the other scriptures, unto their own destruction.
verses.fr: C''est ce qu''il fait dans toutes les lettres, où il parle de ces choses, dans lesquelles il y a des points difficiles à comprendre, dont les personnes ignorantes et mal affermies tordent le sens, comme celui des autres Ecritures, pour leur propre ruine.
verses.am: እንግዲህ እናንተ፥ ወዳጆች ሆይ፥ ይህን አስቀድማችሁ ስለምታውቁ፥ በዓመፀኞቹ ስሕተት ተስባችሁ ከራሳችሁ ጽናት እንዳትወድቁ ተጠንቀቁ፤

verses.en: Ye therefore, beloved, seeing ye know these things before, beware lest ye also, being led away with the error of the wicked, fall from your own stedfastness.
verses.fr: Vous donc, bien-aimés, qui êtes avertis, mettez-vous sur vos gardes, de peur qu''entraînés par l''égarement des impies, vous ne veniez à déchoir de votre fermeté.
verses.am: ነገር ግን በጌታችንና በመድኃኒታችን በኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ ጸጋና እውቀት እደጉ። ለእርሱ አሁንም እስከ ዘላለምም ቀን ድረስ ክብር ይሁን፤ አሜን።

verses.en: But grow in grace, and in the knowledge of our Lord and Saviour Jesus Christ. To him be glory both now and for ever. Amen.
verses.fr: Mais croissez dans la grâce et dans la connaissance de notre Seigneur et Sauveur Jésus-Christ. A lui soit la gloire, maintenant et pour l''éternité! Amen!
verses.am: ነገር ግን በጌታችንና በመድኃኒታችን በኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ ጸጋና እውቀት እደጉ። ለእርሱ አሁንም እስከ ዘላለምም ቀን ድረስ ክብር ይሁን፤ አሜን።
